question:
The following bar graph shows the production of Basmati rice (in tons) over the years. Based on the following graph answer the question below.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4fb436b890f81b363a413a14fa9bd45da0ac1fbceb14add9de0f97dec518a4d7.png] 

What is the approximate percentage increase in Basmati rice production in 2015 as compared to Basmati rice production in 2012?
solution:
**Given:**

Production in 2012 = 32 tons

Production in 2015 = 45 tons

**Formula used:**

Percentage increase = [(Final value - Initial value) / Initial value] × 100

**Calculations:**

⇒ Percentage increase = [(45 - 32) / 32] × 100

⇒ Percentage increase = [13 / 32] × 100

⇒ Percentage increase = 0.40625 × 100

⇒ Percentage increase ≈ 40.63%

**∴ The approximate percentage increase in Basmati rice production in 2015 compared to 2012 is 40.6%.**
